name: How long does a typical home remodeling project take from start to finish?

mainEntity.name: How long does a typical home remodeling project take from start to finish?

acceptedAnswer.text: A full interior remodel typically takes anywhere from three weeks for a single bathroom to several months for a multi-room or basement finish. The overall duration depends on whether your layout changes require new framing, plumbing relocations, or extensive drywall work. In an owner-operated setup like HH Remodeling, finish carpentry, drywall repairs, tile installation, and painting are managed directly on-site while licensed trade partners handle specialized rough-ins. Delays often happen when specialty materials such as custom tile, marble slabs, or specialty cabinetry are backordered. Finalizing your finishes before construction begins keeps the schedule steady.
acceptedAnswer.description: Most single-room remodels take three to six weeks, while full basements or multi-room renovations can take two to three months depending on framing and finish details.
